verdict.rationale: BigCommerce documents REST and GraphQL APIs to manage products programmatically and automate store processes, which covers the API route for catalog changes without editing products one at a time. Nothing in the pack shows CSV import or export, or explicit bulk and batch editing. A secondhand community remark about API throttling is too vague to count as a dispute, but it lowers confidence. Missing for 10: CSV catalog import/export documentation, explicit bulk/batch product update endpoints or tooling, bulk-edit UI evidence, independent hands-on corroboration of large-scale catalog operations.
